## Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load the standardized panel

```{r}
X  <- readRDS(here("data", "dfm", "panel_standardized.rds"))
Xm <- as.matrix(select(X, -date))
```

## Principal components

```{r}
pca <- prcomp(Xm, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)   # already standardized

# how much of the panel's movement each component captures
round(summary(pca)$importance[, 1:5], 3)

# loadings on the first component (sign chosen so most are positive)
if (sum(pca$rotation[, 1]) < 0) pca$rotation[, 1] <- -pca$rotation[, 1]
sort(round(pca$rotation[, 1], 2), decreasing = TRUE)
```

## Plot the first component against headline

```{r}
results_sa <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "local_level_sa_results.rds"))

pc1 <- tibble(date = X$date, pc1 = as.numeric(Xm %*% pca$rotation[, 1])) |>
  left_join(select(results_sa, date, headline = pi_sa), by = "date") |>
  mutate(across(c(pc1, headline), ~ (.x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

p_pc1 <- pc1 |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Standardized", colour = NULL)
p_pc1
ggsave(here("output", "dfm_figures", "pc1_vs_headline.png"),
       p_pc1, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Step 5: DFM parameters from the principal components

```{r}
v      <- pca$rotation[, 1]
d1     <- pca$sdev[1]^2
f_pc   <- as.numeric(Xm %*% v) / sqrt(d1)   # PCA factor, scaled to variance 1
lambda <- v * sqrt(d1)                      # loadings
psi    <- apply(Xm - outer(f_pc, lambda), 2, var)   # each division's own noise variance

ar1    <- arima(f_pc, order = c(1, 0, 0), include.mean = FALSE)
phi    <- unname(ar1$coef["ar1"])
sig2_u <- ar1$sigma2

tibble(code         = names(lambda),
       loading      = round(lambda, 2),
       noise_var    = round(psi, 2),
       share_common = round(lambda^2 / (lambda^2 + psi), 2)) |>
  arrange(desc(share_common))

c(phi = phi, sig2_u = sig2_u)

dfm_params <- list(lambda = lambda, psi = psi, phi = phi, sig2_u = sig2_u)
saveRDS(dfm_params, here("data", "dfm", "dfm_params.rds"))
```

## Step 6: Kalman filter for the common factor

```{r}
dfm_filter <- function(Xm, lambda, psi, phi, sig2_u) {
  n      <- nrow(Xm)
  f_filt <- numeric(n)
  P_filt <- numeric(n)
  f_prev <- 0
  P_prev <- sig2_u / (1 - phi^2)            # start from the factor's long-run spread
  info   <- sum(lambda^2 / psi)             # total reliability of one month's data

  for (t in 1:n) {
    f_pred <- phi * f_prev                  # 1. predict from last month
    P_pred <- phi^2 * P_prev + sig2_u
    P_filt[t] <- 1 / (1 / P_pred + info)    # 2. combine prediction with this month's votes
    f_filt[t] <- P_filt[t] * (f_pred / P_pred + sum(lambda * Xm[t, ] / psi))
    f_prev <- f_filt[t]
    P_prev <- P_filt[t]
  }
  tibble(f_filt, P_filt)
}

filt <- dfm_filter(Xm, lambda, psi, phi, sig2_u) |>
  mutate(date = X$date, f_pc = f_pc, .before = 1)
saveRDS(filt, here("data", "dfm", "dfm_filtered_factor.rds"))

# checks
cor(filt$f_filt, filt$f_pc)
round(sort(lambda^2 / psi / sum(lambda^2 / psi), decreasing = TRUE), 2)
```

## Plot: filtered factor vs PCA factor

```{r}
p_filt <- filt |>
  select(date, `Kalman filter` = f_filt, PCA = f_pc) |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Common factor (standardized)", colour = NULL)
p_filt
ggsave(here("output", "dfm_figures", "factor_filtered_vs_pca.png"),
       p_filt, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Step 7: DFM core inflation (headline projected on the factor)

```{r}
results_sa <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "local_level_sa_results.rds"))

core_df <- filt |>
  select(date, f_filt) |>
  inner_join(select(results_sa, date, pi_sa), by = "date")

reg <- lm(pi_sa ~ f_filt, data = core_df)
coef(reg)
summary(reg)$r.squared

core_df <- core_df |>
  mutate(dfm_core = coef(reg)[1] + coef(reg)[2] * f_filt,
         dfm_yoy  = 100 * (exp(zoo::rollmeanr(dfm_core, 12, fill = NA) / 100) - 1))
saveRDS(core_df, here("data", "dfm", "dfm_core.rds"))
```

## Compare with all other measures

```{r}
comparison_dfm <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "comparison_yoy_all.rds")) |>
  left_join(select(core_df, date, dfm_yoy), by = "date")
saveRDS(comparison_dfm, here("data", "dfm", "comparison_yoy_with_dfm.rds"))

p_dfm <- comparison_dfm |>
  filter(date >= ymd("2017-01-01")) |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Year-over-year inflation (%)", colour = NULL)
p_dfm
ggsave(here("output", "dfm_figures", "dfm_vs_all_measures.png"),
       p_dfm, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

comparison_dfm |> filter(date >= ymd("2025-10-01")) |> print(width = Inf)
```

## Diagnostic: year-over-year inflation by division, winter 2025-26

```{r}
div <- readRDS(here("data", "dfm", "division_indices_2023base.rds"))

div |>
  group_by(code) |>
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(yoy = round(100 * (index / lag(index, 12) - 1), 1)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(date %in% ymd(c("2025-10-01", "2026-02-01", "2026-08-01"))) |>
  select(code, date, yoy) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = date, values_from = yoy) |>
  arrange(`2026-02-01`)
```
